blocks.text: “ADDICTED” BUILDS ON PREVIOUS SINGLE “CLICK,” DEEPENING THE THEME OF CONNECTION AND CAPTURING THE INTOXICATING PULL OF AN IRRESISTIBLE ATTRACTION Today, global pop icon JISOO reveals the next chapter of this exciting new era of her solo career: “ADDICTED,” a driving dance-pop single that embodies the dizzy thrill of uncontrollable attraction with a dark sonic palette and an infectious beat. Listen to “ADDICTED” HERE via Warner Records, and watch the music video HERE. “ADDICTED” opens on crackling thunders before unleashing an enthralling mix of eerie synths, raw bass, and disco-infused rhythms.
